Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Eric Woods (E019)
Requested: write access to Payroll

Facts:
- Role: Engineer (both notes agree)
- Employment type: contractor (both notes agree)
- Security training: Note 1 says no training info on file; Note 2 says basic training (looked up in own database)

Policy for contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So contractor maximum: read (no advanced training) or write (with advanced training).

Both notes recommend read. Note 2 says basic training, which is not advanced, so write is not permitted.

The requested level is write, which is above the maximum (read). So grant the maximum, which is read.

Also, must never grant more than requested — read is less than write, fine.

Decision: read.
